hardware_model_status: D405 wrists and D435i head are explicit simulation selections, not confirmed installed serial-specific hardware

head.mount_evidence: Official DACH xacro head-camera reference; the generated URDF instead contains a body-fixed d435 placeholder

left.mount_evidence: V3 side mount: CAD local holes60/120 transformed to original adapter small holes330/30 on the thumb side; large15 retention hole covered

right.mount_evidence: Both hands have their thumb on original adapter +X; same V3 wrist transform, no inherited right-side180-degree rotation

D405.intrinsic_status: nominal datasheet FOV pinhole, not per-device calibration

D435i.intrinsic_status: nominal datasheet FOV pinhole, depth range is a configurable preview gate, not a hardware specification

notes: V4 angle convention: plate_tilt_deg is the angle BETWEEN the plate and stem. A user value15 means CAD rotation Rx75, not Rx15.
User-authorized new design from photos and measured interfaces; unreadable original STEP is not a prerequisite and is not claimed reconstructed.
V3 uses side small holes330/30, separated by60degrees and30.5mm atR30.5. The former back-side120degree hole pair is not reused.
The stem extends on the thumb side, perpendicular to the prior back-side extension. The large retention hole at15degrees is deliberately covered.
No horizontal arm or large access relief is added. Wrist mounting and camera mounting use separate small-hole pairs.
Length is the blue stem extension along local +Z, measured from fixed saddle-top Z=35.8 mm; it is not the old +Y arm length.
Plate tilt rebuilds only the green mounting plate and its root transition; saddle and vertical stem orientation remain fixed.
Parameter changes regenerate cached STEP/STL solids and reload the scene, not merely a camera-frame translation.
Camera is a separate RealSense model, attached through its two rear M3 mounting holes, never fused into the bracket STEP.
All RGB/depth are ideal pinhole renderings; no stereo matching, projector, noise, rolling shutter, material-dependent failure, or IMU simulation.
D435i color and depth use distinct optical origins and FOVs; raw depth is not registered to color.
Existing body-fixed d435_Link is retained and is not relabeled as the head camera.
